hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
BLACK_LIST=~jenkins/dns_blacklist.txt DIR="/localdisk/designer/jenkins/debian-master/repo"
REPEATS=5 ERR=0 for TARGET in $( grep -rIhE "(https?|ftp)://[^/ )\"'>]+" $DIR \ --exclude-dir={.git,node_modules,venv,__pycache__,build,man,qa,centos,dist,.cache,docs,doc,test,tests,changelog} \ --exclude={*.rst,*.md,*.txt,*.texi,copyright,README,LICENSE,COPYING,MAINTAINERS,[Cc]hange[Ll]og*,*release-notes} | \ grep -vE '^\s*(#|//|/\*|<!--)' | \ grep -v 'Bug-Debian:' | \ grep -v 'bugs.debian.org' | \ grep -v 'debian-master' | \ grep -v '^[*][ ]' | \ grep -v '^[ ][*][ ]' | \ grep -oE "(https?|ftp)://[^/ )\"'>]+" | \ grep -vE '[@$]' | \ sed -E 's#(https?|ftp)://([^/:]+).*#\2#' | \ grep -v -f $BLACK_LIST | \ grep -vE '^[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,3}){3}$' | \ sort -u); do if REPLY=$(nslookup $TARGET) ; then echo "$REPLY" if echo $REPLY | grep 'No answer'; then sleep 2 else for i in $(seq 1 $REPEATS); do if ! nslookup $TARGET ; then ERR=1 fi done fi else echo "$REPLY" sleep 2 fi done exit $ERR
